Agreement between the Government of Belize and the Government of the Republic of China (Taiwan) concerning Investment Protection (Belize–Taiwan Investment Protection Agreement)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270 of the Laws of Belize (Revised Edition 2020), as amended by the International Business Companies (Amendment) Act 2019 (mandating a confidential beneficial ownership register for IBCs maintained by the licensed registered agent and accessible to the Registrar of Companies, the International Financial Services Commission and the Financial Intelligence Unit); Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act, Cap. 104:02 of the Laws of Belize, as amended, together with its Regulations and the AML/CFT Guidance Notes issued by the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and the Belize International Financial Services Commission (IFSC); Companies (Amendment) Act 2019 (domestic beneficial ownership register regime); International Financial Services Commission Act, Cap. 272 of the Laws of Belize, as amended.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or competent passport authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing state is a contracting party to the Hague Apostille Convention of 1961; otherwise Consular Legalization by the Belize consular/embassy authority in the issuing country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, regulated financial institution or issuing government agency
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for Hague Convention member states; Consular Legalization for non-member states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank or licensed financial institution in the applicant's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence under the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act, Cap. 104:02 and the AML/CFT Guidance Notes of the Belize FIU and IFSC: every UBO, director and shareholder must be screened before incorporation against the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, the US OFAC SDN and Non-SDN lists, the European Union consolidated financial sanctions list, the UK HM Treasury sanctions list, and Belize's domestic FIU watchlists and adverse-media sources. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) — domestic and foreign — trigger Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) requiring source-of-wealth and source-of-funds documentation, senior management approval and heightened ongoing monitoring. Screening results must be documented, archived and made available to the Belize registered agent and any requesting competent authority, and retained for at least five years after the termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (Registrar of Companies, Government of Belize) — IBC name clearance and reservation are filed electronically by licensed Belize registered agents through the Registry's online application portal; direct public self-service web filing for IBC name clearance is not available.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the sole official business language; proposed IBC names must be expressed in Roman (Latin) characters; no non-Latin script or transliteration from Cyrillic, Arabic, Chinese or other scripts is accepted; names must be distinguishable from existing registered names and from names reserved under the IBC Act, and must reflect a permitted corporate ending such as Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, Sociedad Anonima, LTD, CORP, INC or SA.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed name, the licensed registered agent files a formal written administrative appeal/re-submission with the Registrar of Companies, setting out statutory compliance arguments (i.e. the name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing or reserved name, contains no prohibited token requiring ministerial consent, and does not offend public policy). The Registrar is expected to issue a determination within approximately 14–21 business days. If the administrative appeal is denied, the applicant may (i) request the International Financial Services Commission to intervene or issue a declaratory ruling on the use of the name, and (ii) thereafter seek judicial review by originating notice of motion before the Supreme Court of Judicature of Belize under the rules of natural justice. A fresh reservation with a new filing fee is typically required because extensions beyond the initial 30-day reservation window are not automatically granted.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office is not permissible as the statutory registered office: the IBC must at all times maintain a physical registered office in Belize at the office address of its licensed registered agent, open for receipt of service of process, regulatory communications and official correspondence. The underlying UI/UX design-as-a-service subscription business may be operated entirely remotely from any location, consistent with the IBC regime's zero-physical-presence relief, but the registered office address cannot be substituted with a virtual mailbox or a non-Belize address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection by the IFSC/FIU/Registrar at less than 5% to 10% per year for this low-risk standard-tier subscription design business, with inspections most likely triggered by adverse media coverage, a suspicious transaction report, a regulator sampling exercise, or the emergence of a PEP or sanctions match; the registered agent's Belize premises remain subject to lawful warrantless inspection under AML/CFT supervision powers.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270, Laws of Belize, Revised Edition 2020, as amended — ss. 4 (incorporation), 9 (Certificate of Incorporation), 15 (registered office and registered agent), 18 (share capital); supplemented by the Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry administrative directives under the Companies (Amendment) Act 2022.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, Ministry of Finance, Government of Belize
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (IBC Form) with issuance of a Certificate of Incorporation under s. 9 of the International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital requirement for an IBC; authorized share capital may be expressed in any currency, and no escrow or bank deposit confirmation is required at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Articles of Incorporation filed with the Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry be adopted as the Company's governing instrument. RESOLVED, that the subscription for 5,000 common shares of no par value be accepted, allotted, and issued to the initial subscriber. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the address of the licensed registered agent in Belize City, Belize. RESOLVED, that [Director Name] be appointed as sole Director, and [Officer Name] as President and [Officer Name] as Secretary-Treasurer, each to serve until resignation or removal. RESOLVED, that Stripe Billing and Wise be approved as the Company's subscription payment rails. RESOLVED, that the officers be authorized to execute all ancillary filings and maintain the statutory registers.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation company name search and reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR) — submission through a licensed Belize registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name availability search against the IBC and domestic company registers to confirm that the proposed name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing entity; file a name reservation application through the licensed registered agent; the reservation is typically held for 30 days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, the applicant may select an alternative name and re-file the search application, or submit a written submission to CCAR requesting reconsideration with supporting evidence of distinctiveness.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and notary public in Belize
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation stating the corporate name, registered office address, registered agent details, authorized share capital, currency, and the number of initial directors; execute the Articles before a notary public or witness in accordance with the IBC Act formalities.
required_dossiers: Signed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
Consent to act as registered agent
Identity and address evidence of the incorporator or subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If CCAR raises a defect in the Articles, file the prescribed rectification or amendment instrument and re-submit; cure any notarization irregularity within five business days of the requisition.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: E-filing of incorporation application with the Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, Ministry of Finance, Belize City, Belize
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed Articles of Incorporation, the registered agent's certificate, the statutory declaration of compliance, and beneficial ownership particulars through the CCAR e-filing portal or in person at the registry counter; pay the required fees and obtain a filing acknowledgement.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the Registrar's requisition letter by filing corrective amendments or supplementary declarations; if the application is refused, an appeal may be lodged with the Registrar within 14 days of the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of incorporation and first-year license fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry — treasury and payments section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the official incorporation fee of US$200 (for authorized capital up to US$10,000) plus the first annual license fee of US$100 minimum, by wire transfer, bank draft, or in-person payment at the registry treasury; retain the stamped receipt for the file.
required_dossiers: Payment receipt or wire transfer confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is rejected or incorrectly applied, present proof of remittance to the Registry's finance section and request reallocation or refund; escalation to the Registrar for waiver of late-payment penalties if the error was administrative.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and establishment of statutory registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation; the company must then confirm the registered office at the registered agent's Belize address and prepare the statutory registers, including the register of shareholders, directors, officers, and charges.
required_dossiers: Registered agent confirmation of registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains errors, request an administrative correction with supporting documents; if the registered office confirmation is defective, execute a fresh consent and file the notification with CCAR.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of First Board Resolution and appointment of officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Belize IBC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass a unanimous written resolution to: accept the share subscription and issue share certificates; fix the registered office; appoint the directors and officers; approve the use of Stripe Billing and Wise as subscription payment rails; and authorize the opening of corporate bank and payment accounts.
required_dossiers: Bank and payment provider onboarding forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a consent or appointment is defective, obtain a fresh consent and ratify the prior action by a supplemental board resolution; re-filing with the registry is required only if the officers' details are recorded on the public register.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — the IBC does not carry on business in Belize; trade licensing and industrial permitting are waived for wholly offshore digital design service providers under the International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required — no industrial, manufacturing, or physical operating permit is triggered for ISIC 7410 UI/UX design subscription services operating as Design-As-A-Service.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment, Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management, Belize
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no physical project, construction, or land development in Belize
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero local discharge — no wastewater, VOC, or hazardous waste streams are generated; compliance thresholds would apply only if the company later establishes physical premises, triggering full EIA screening under the Environmental Protection Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable — no physical premises, inventory, or employees in Belize; fire safety certification, structural load inspections, and workplace occupational clearance are not triggered for a digital-only offshore entity.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Services Department (BTS), Ministry of Finance; online portal: https://www.taxservice.gov.bz
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign beneficial owner establishes an International Business Company (IBC) through a licensed registered agent who files incorporation documents with the Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR). The IBC receives a unique CCAR registration number and is statutorily exempt from Belize income tax, capital gains tax, and General Sales Tax (GST) with automatic issuance of a Tax Exemption Certificate under the International Business Companies Act. No separate VAT/GST registration is required for qualifying IBCs. If the IBC nonetheless engages in a taxable activity within Belize, the entity must apply to the Belize Tax Services Department for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) using the relevant GST registration form within 14 days of becoming liable to register.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Belize does not operate a U.S.-style check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election. An IBC may voluntarily elect to be subject to Belize income tax under the Income and Business Tax Act by converting to a domestic Belize company, but such election terminates IBC tax-exempt status. An IBC may also obtain enhanced confidentiality protections under the IBC Act, but no further tax classification elections are available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory GST registration applies to any business whose annual taxable turnover exceeds BZD 75,000 (Belize dollars); voluntary registration is permitted below this threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Belize does not currently impose a mandatory real-time electronic invoicing clearance, API-based fiscal stamping, or machine-readable clearance mandate. GST-registered suppliers must issue sequential numbered fiscal invoices/receipts and retain original records for at least six years. Electronic invoicing is permitted where prior approval is obtained from the Belize Tax Services Department.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods from Belize are zero-rated under the GST Act where the goods are physically removed from Belize and the supplier retains sufficient documentary proof of export. International services supplied to non-residents are generally treated as supplied outside Belize and are therefore outside the scope of Belize GST, provided the place of supply rules are satisfied. For an International Business Company, cross-border UI/UX design subscription services rendered to foreign clients are not subject to Belize GST because of the statutory IBC exemption; no GST is charged, and therefore no input tax credit refund mechanism is typically engaged.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank statement evidencing receipt of foreign currency proceeds
Commercial invoice issued to the overseas buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Belize Tax Services Department and the Comptroller of Customs may audit export transactions within six years. Fraudulent zero-rating claims, false documentation, or failure to substantiate export delivery within the statutory period render the supply taxable at 12.5% GST with retrospective clawback, interest, and penalties. Under the GST Act, deliberate evasion attracts fines up to twice the tax evaded and/or imprisonment; separate offenses under the Customs and Excise Duty Act apply to falsified export declarations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Belize maintains a fixed exchange rate regime with the Belize dollar (BZD) pegged at 2 BZD per 1 USD. Current account transactions, including payments for design subscription services, are generally freely convertible. Capital account transactions, including inbound capital injections and repatriation of capital, are subject to exchange control approval under the Exchange Control Act. IBCs operating as non-resident entities are exempt from exchange control regulations provided they do not conduct business with Belize residents or maintain domestic currency accounts. Profit remittances from operational accounts may require documentary evidence of tax compliance and underlying trade invoices. Dividends and service fees payable to non-residents are permitted but may be subject to withholding tax only if sourced from Belize domestic business activity; IBCs are tax-exempt and typically incur no Belize withholding taxes on foreign-source income.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Belize does not impose mandatory surrender requirements on export proceeds for IBCs. Export receipts denominated in foreign currency may be retained in foreign currency accounts with authorized dealers without conversion into Belize dollars. There is no statutory timeline requiring repatriation of export proceeds to Belize. However, if an IBC maintains a Belize-dollar domestic account, the Exchange Control Act requires that foreign currency receipts be offered for conversion to an authorized dealer within a reasonable period; IBCs structured as non-resident entities are normally excluded from this requirement. For operational efficiency, the entity should designate all subscription receipts as foreign currency (USD) and maintain USD-denominated offshore or domestic foreign-currency accounts.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low for Belize-regulated EMIs, as Belize does not have a mature EMI licensing framework. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise and Payoneer are viable as payment collection rails for inbound subscription fees and outbound disbursements, subject to their own KYC policies and jurisdiction risk assessments. Legal constraints: Belize IBCs are recognized as valid corporate clients by most international EMIs; however, a physical presence or registered agent confirmation may be required. The IBC must provide a certificate of good standing, registered agent letter, and beneficial ownership declaration. Belize's FATF status must be monitored; as of the knowledge cutoff, Belize remains on the FATF grey list for strategic deficiencies, which may trigger enhanced due diligence (EDD) by EMIs. Third-party processor restrictions may apply, and the entity should primarily use Wise Business accounts with USD receiving details and not rely on a Belize-domiciled EMI for cross-border clearing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors is generally not required for Belize IBC accounts if remote onboarding facilities are offered; however, most tier-1 domestic banks (Belize Bank, Atlantic Bank) require directors, shareholders, and the beneficial owner to appear in person or at a Belize embassy consulate for verification, unless the account is opened through an introducing agent with an existing banking relationship. Caye International Bank and Heritage Bank offer remote onboarding with video KYC and notarized documents. Due to Belize's grey-list status, enhanced due diligence commonly requires directors to provide notarized passport copies, utility bills, a banker's reference from the home-country bank, and a physical meeting with a correspondent bank or local introducer, particularly when the operational account will handle subscription payments from multiple unrelated clients.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Grey-list jurisdiction flag: Belize IBC with non-resident beneficial owner transacting US-dollar subscription revenue from global clients
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Beneficial ownership declaration with full name, nationality, residential address, and source of wealth; corporate register extract and certificate of good standing from Belize's Companies Registry; registered agent compliance letter confirming IBC good standing and registered office; audited or management financial statements showing the UI/UX design subscription business model; sample client agreements with service descriptions and billing terms; comprehensive business plan explaining design-as-a-service deliverables, staffing, and payment flow; source-of-funds evidence for initial capital injection (bank statements and contract of sale or funding letter); home-country tax identification number and tax residence certificate; and a written AML narrative addressing FATF grey-list items and demonstrating enhanced monitoring controls.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk geography mismatch: Belize IBC physically managed from a different jurisdiction, with directors holding passports from multiple countries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized passports of all directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners; proof of residential address for each principal; original banker's reference letters from a regulated financial institution in each principal's home country; curriculum vitae and professional references for executive management; corporate organizational chart; and board resolution appointing a Belize resident registered agent and any local managing director.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of subscription revenue and digital-asset exposure: Payment volumes from Stripe and Wise with no physical office, or crypto-related top-ups may flag sanctions screening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Verified Stripe and Wise settlement statements showing merchant of record status; chargeback history and disputes metrics; target market description excluding sanctioned jurisdictions; OFAC/Sanctions screening certification for all clients; legal opinion on cross-border digital service contracts; compliance manual containing customer due diligence and transaction monitoring procedures; and bank statement history for the first six months of operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: IBC nominee shareholder or bearer share structure triggers enhanced beneficial ownership review
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Declaration of trust if nominee shareholders are used; complete trust deed and letter of wishes; unredacted register of members (or legal confirmation of availability); consent letters from all ultimate beneficial owners; and a legal opinion from Belize counsel confirming compliance with the Beneficial Ownership Act and Companies (Amendment) Act transparency requirements.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial share capital and paid-in surplus must be injected via SWIFT wire transfer from the beneficial owner's private account or a holding company account in USD. Recommended routing: originating bank in an OECD jurisdiction -> SWIFT MT103 with purpose code G50 (Insurance, business services) for equity injection, or extended purpose code 812 (other equities) depending on receiving bank's classification. Reference should clearly state 'Contribution to share capital / paid-in surplus — BZ IBC [Name]'. The receiving bank should be either Caye International Bank (more accommodating to remote IBC clients) or Belize Bank. For amounts below USD 10,000, verification is typically relaxed; amounts above USD 50,000 will require source-of-wealth documentation, including account statements, contract evidencing proceeds, and a board resolution. To avoid anti-money-laundering triggers, all injections must originate from a jurisdiction with a strong AML framework (US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia). Belize IBC minimum authorized capital is typically USD 50,000 but paid-up capital may be minimal; unless escrow requirements apply, an initial operating funded amount of USD 10,000–50,000 is commercially reasonable.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: All outbound disbursements for design trade partners, freelancers, software tools, and operational expenses should be cleared through SWIFT MT103 or MT202 for interbank transfers. For vendor payments exceeding USD 10,000, use MT103 with purpose code according to the nature of services: code 191 (professional fees), code 902 (computer software and related services), or general code NBS (business services). If the receiving counterparty supports commercial letters of credit, an LC is permissible but unnecessary for subscription business; only use standbys for client engagements if contractually required. For payouts to designers and sub-contractors, Wise Business provides lower cost clearing rails and can receive USD via ACH/wire and convert to local currency using mid-market rates. The recommended disbursement hierarchy is: (1) Stripe for refunds and merchant payouts; (2) Wise for small vendor payments (< USD 10,000) and multi-currency settlements; (3) SWIFT MT103 from the primary bank account for strategic vendor payments and tax payments; (4) local RTGS if Belize-dollar payments to domestic suppliers are ever needed (e.g., Belize administrative costs). All outbound payment requisitions must be supported by invoices and a documented payment sign-off matrix, and funds must match the business activity description 'UI/UX design subscription and digital product design services' to avoid description mismatches.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD-denominated onshore forward contracts with authorized dealers in Belize for converting BZD receipts to USD
Offshore deliverable USD/BZD forwards executed through non-resident banks only if the contract settles offshore and does not involve a Belize resident counterparty
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing BZD/USD where settlement occurs in USD; however, availability is limited due to Belize's fixed peg and shallow offshore market

Cross-currency swaps between USD and major operational currencies (EUR, GBP, CAD) for vendor settlement risk, executed through the home-country treasury of the beneficial owner or a tier-1 international bank
Covered options on USD/EUR or USD/GBP to hedge design-contract receivables from non-US clients
No speculative derivatives permitted: all FX hedging must be economically linked to receivables, payables, or share-capital repatriation exposures

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of the International Business Company (Registry confirmation of officers, members and registered office; submitted concurrently with the annual government fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Business Companies, Belize Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 30 September; first return is due by 30 September of the year following incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 50% of the unpaid annual fee is assessed after the 30 September deadline; continued non-payment for approximately 12 months may lead to administrative strike-off and dissolution, with restoration requiring payment of all arrears, reinstatement fees and Registrar-imposed penalties

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a non-licensed Belize IBC; no statutory audit is required under the International Business Companies Act. Mandatory independent audit applies only where the company holds a regulated financial license, is directed by the Registrar or a court, or where economic substance rules impose a local filing obligation requiring audited accounts.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Books and financial records may be maintained under IFRS or another recognized accounting framework, including US GAAP; the IBC Act requires records sufficient to disclose financial position and to enable true and fair presentation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: On any share transfer, the directors must update the Register of Members and notify the registered agent immediately so that the confidential beneficial ownership register is revised. The registered agent collects fresh UBO confirmation during the annual corporate secretarial review; no public beneficial ownership filing is required in Belize, but the Annual Return confirms that the statutory registers have been properly updated.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit required; voluntary certified audit or review typically USD 1,500 – 4,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IBC Act (Cap. 270) s.6(2)-(3) grants a permanent exemption from all Belize taxes: no income tax, no capital gains/chargeable gains tax, no withholding tax on dividends, interest or royalties, and no stamp duty on IBC instruments. General Belize resident corporate rate (outside IBC regime): 25%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IBC Annual Return (prescribed form under s.100, IBC Act Cap. 270); filed with the Registrar of International Business Companies via the Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR) electronic filing portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation each year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact name of the International Business Company
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the certified name as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; no trading or assumed names permitted without prior registration.
Enter the unique number assigned by the Registrar at incorporation.
Must be a physical address in Belize maintained by a licensed registered agent; P.O. boxes are not acceptable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the licensed registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must be a Belize-licensed service provider; foreign directors cannot act as registered agents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors' full names, nationalities, and residential addresses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are fully permitted; no Belize residency requirement. Corporate directors are allowed under the IBC Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholders' full names, nationalities, and residential addresses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List all registered shareholders; bearer shares have been prohibited; nominee shareholder arrangements must be disclosed to the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital and class of shares
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the full authorized capital in Belize dollars or other currency; the minimum capital requirement is nil.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of compliance and authorized signature
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Sign electronically as director, officer, or registered agent; must certify that the company is solvent, carrying on business in compliance with the IBC Act, and has no outstanding levy obligations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs an automatic surcharge of BZD 200. Continued default beyond 3 months triggers administrative strike-off, forfeiture of assets to the Government of Belize, and reinstatement only by court order with full arrears, penalties, and costs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return (prescribed ESR form under the Economic Substance Act 2019, as amended in 2021); filed with the Belize Competent Authority / Economic Substance Unit through the designated electronic filing system operated by the IFSC Registry.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months after the end of the company's financial year (e.g., 30 June for a 31 December year-end).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification: name, registration number, date of incorporation, financial year-end
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reference exact details from the IBC Certificate of Incorporation; if the financial year differs from the calendar year, state the actual year-end adopted.

Declare whether the IBC is tax resident in Belize, a foreign jurisdiction, or has no tax residence. A UI/UX design subscription IBC managed and controlled outside Belize should declare foreign/non-residence and, where available, attach evidence of foreign tax residence.

Indicate whether the entity undertakes any listed 'relevant activity'. Design-as-a-service delivered to unrelated third-party subscribers is generally outside the 'distribution and service centre' category, which targets services to related parties; mark 'none' if no relevant activity is conducted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Core income-generating activities (CIGA) performed in Belize
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident IBC, confirm that all CIGA (client contracting, design production, subscription management, billing via Stripe/Wise) are performed overseas; for a Belize-resident IBC, describe specific CIGA conducted physically in Belize.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Substance indicators: premises, full-time employees, operating expenditure, equipment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident IBCs report nil for Belize premises/employees; resident IBCs must quantify leased office premises, headcount, payroll, and proportionate expenditure incurred in Belize for the relevant activity.

State gross income and deductible expenditure attributable to each relevant activity; exempt IBC income requires no tax computation, but amounts must be consistent with audited or management accounts.
Executed by a director, manager, or authorized representative; knowingly false declarations constitute a criminal offence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Administrative fixed penalty for late or non-filing (up to USD 5,000 / BZD 10,000 per offence), daily default surcharges for continuing breach, criminal fines up to BZD 50,000 for knowingly false statements, mandatory exchange of information with foreign tax authorities, and risk of strike-off.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (nil) for dividends paid by an IBC to non-resident shareholders under IBC Act s.6(3); the general 15% non-resident dividend withholding rate under the Income Tax Act does not apply to IBCs.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Treaty relief is unnecessary for Belize-source passive flows because statutory IBC exemption already eliminates withholding taxes. Where a foreign shareholder seeks foreign tax credit recognition, the IBC should obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence from the Belize Tax Authority evidencing residence status; the certificate is submitted to the foreign revenue authority, not to Belizean authorities. Belize's DTA network is minimal (the CARICOM Double Taxation Agreement and a small number of bilateral arrangements); no DTA article is required to obtain the 0% domestic IBC result.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and interest paid by an IBC: 0% WHT under the IBC Act exemption. Statutory non-resident WHT rates under the general Income Tax Act are 15% for interest and 15% for royalties, but these are ousted by s.6 IBC Act for IBC payors. No Belize source tax is levied on subscription revenue received by the IBC from non-resident clients.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory Local File / Master File threshold exists under Belize law; the Income Tax Act s.32 grants the Tax Authority pricing adjustment powers only over taxable entities. A fully tax-exempt IBC has no Belize TP documentation obligation, but any IBC that elects Belize tax residence and undertakes a relevant activity must retain contemporaneous arm's-length evidence (contracts, comparables, pricing rationales) for all related-party transactions to satisfy substance and information-exchange scrutiny.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Act 2019 (as amended 2021) applies. A Belize tax-resident IBC carrying on a 'relevant activity' (including a distribution and service centre, where services are rendered to related parties) must demonstrate CIGA performed in Belize, adequate local premises, full-time employees, and operating expenditure proportionate to income. A UI/UX design subscription agency serving unrelated third-party subscribers falls outside the 'relevant activity' list and is subject only to the annual return and declaration requirements. A non-resident IBC must file a nil/simplified return confirming its foreign tax residence. Failure to satisfy substance requirements is reportable to foreign tax authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly or recklessly filing false declarations in the Economic Substance Return, submitting inaccurate annual returns, concealing taxable activities outside the IBC exemption, or misdeclaring tax residence to avoid foreign taxation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fines up to BZD 50,000 under the Economic Substance Act; penalties under the Income Tax Act of 20% of the tax shortfall plus monthly interest; exposure to the Belize criminal fraud statutes; mandatory disclosure of the evasion to foreign tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who sign false declarations face personal fines, imprisonment up to 2 years, civil restitution of wrongful distributions, and travel bans during criminal investigation; courts may pierce the corporate veil.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Belize-resident IBC with no physical premises, no employees, no local CIGA, and no operating expenditure in Belize while declaring tax residence in Belize, or carrying on a relevant activity without satisfying the substance tests.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties of up to BZD 50,000 per offence under the Economic Substance Act, daily default fines, automatic exchange of information to the foreign tax authority of the ultimate beneficial owner, compulsory striking-off, and forfeiture of assets to the Government of Belize.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors authorizing false residence or substance declarations are personally liable for fines and penalties; repeated violations trigger disqualification orders, travel bans, and personal liability for company debts under veil-piercing doctrines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Utilizing the IBC to launder funds, conceal beneficial ownership, accept fraudulent subscription payments through Stripe or Wise, transact with sanctioned persons, or knowingly process proceeds of crime through the payment rails.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act and Financial Intelligence Unit Act: fines up to BZD 50,000 per offence, imprisonment up to 10 years, and confiscation of property derived from the offence; suspension or revocation of the corporate licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners with actual or constructive knowledge face criminal conviction, personal asset forfeiture, travel restrictions, inclusion on financial intelligence watch-lists, and permanent disqualification from acting as company officers.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Registry Default and Trading while Struck Off
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the IBC Annual Return by the anniversary date, non-payment of the annual licence fee, failure to file the Economic Substance Return by the statutory deadline, or continuing business operations after administrative strike-off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic late surcharge of BZD 200; strike-off after 3 months of continuing default; all company assets vest in the Government of Belize; striking-off extinguishes the limited liability shield.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who trade while the company is struck off are personally liable for all company debts and obligations incurred during the period; reinstatement is consensual only at the discretion of the Registrar or by court order with full penalty payments.
